currentPhase.description: M3.2 AI Kit Factory design is accepted. Source-to-Draft is rejected for M3.2. The authorized architecture is direct source reading by an author AI, deterministic canonical and M3.1 structural quality gates, independent semantic/source-fidelity review, and a deterministic factory PASS/HOLD gate. Learner runtime and promoted M3.1 authoring remain unchanged.

currentMain.description: Post-M3.2-design main: AI Kit Factory design accepted; no M3.2 product implementation merged yet.

developmentBaseline.note: ATLAS-WP-014 is the next bounded implementation gate authorized by accepted design ATLAS-WP-013. No Source-to-Draft subsystem is authorized.

promotedBaseline.candidate: Project Atlas M2.2 transfer + learner-facing clarity
promotedBaseline.note: Learner runtime baseline remains M2.2 unchanged by M3 authoring. M3.0/M3.1 authoring promotion is recorded separately under acceptedControls.

stageDOperatingModel.policy: disjoint development, independent QA, non-repairing integration and Governor decisions at contract, candidate and promotion boundaries

authorizedWork: ATLAS-WP-014 may implement only the bounded M3.2 AI Kit Factory paths frozen by accepted design ATLAS-WP-013.
QA-WP-022 may be prepared on disjoint QA-owned paths and may issue findings but may not repair product files.
Repository maintenance and evidence-preserving closeout may proceed only under dedicated bounded work packages.
heldWork: Generic Source-to-Draft, PDF/OCR/document normalization and intermediate draft schemas remain outside M3.2 and require a new evidence-backed decision if ever needed.
M3.3 assisted authoring and M3.4 scale/publishing remain HOLD until separately authorized.
Human graphical/contextual author-review debt #272 remains deferred and non-blocking until human review becomes a first-class workflow.
Gate 3 repository-write capability remains HOLD unless separately authorized.
Gate 4 parallel runtime remains HOLD unless separately authorized.
M4 Learn-it Everywhere, backend, accounts, cloud synchronization, remote catalog, commerce, tenancy and marketplace remain HOLD.
Teacher, cohort and institutional features remain HOLD before explicit later-milestone authority.
prohibitedWork: runtime LLM, remote AI API, embedded secret or network-required learning behavior without explicit future authority
direct write to main outside the repository's enforced governed pull-request process
silent product repair by an integration or QA lane in a product-owner file
destructive migration or reuse of protected RC718 storage
claiming certification, durable mastery or retention beyond observed evidence
publishing an artifact different from the exact artifact tested and promoted
embedding M3 authoring or LLM assistance code into the learner runtime artifact

activeRisks.statement: Human review of AI-authored kits lacks a sequence-level graphical/contextual overview; tracked as non-blocking debt #272.
activeRisks.closureGate: Close or supersede issue #272 only after a separately authorized human-review workflow provides sequence-level context and passes its own evidence gate.

nextMandatoryGate.condition: Implement only the accepted M3.2 AI Kit Factory design: no source-ingestion subsystem, no canonical contract change, no model/vendor API, no learner-runtime change. Final acceptance requires independent QA-WP-022 and real-source qualification evidence.

review.lastReviewedBy: Permanent Governor after accountable-owner M3.2 arbitration and accepted AI Kit Factory design
review.nextReviewTrigger: ATLAS-WP-014 candidate freeze, semantic-review contract change, source-ingestion proposal, model/vendor integration proposal, qualification failure, human UX debt #272 reactivation, Gate3/Gate4 request or M4+ proposal
